_doc: Linh thú (spirit beasts). Spec: design/quick-specs/phu-luc-linh-thu-thanh-tuu.md. Owned beasts are people records with owner_id; they cultivate in the world tick, add power_share of their chiến lực to the owner's offense, follow the owner, and eat feed_lt_by_realm linh thạch a year. tame chance = base + (Thần hồn - than_hon_neutral) x than_hon_per_point + Ngự thú level x per_skill_level, clamped to [min, max].
